subject: Scaling Robotics Infrastructure
text:
Hi [NAME],

With your amount of data and team growing rapidly following your Series A,
we often find this stage is a key inflection point where teams start to
feel the need for more scalable solutions to help them train their models
efficiently. Am I on the right lines with ARX?

I work in the Robotics team at Encord, where we've built an end-to-end data
development platform that combines data curation, annotation, workflow
management, and model observability into one integrated solution - helping
AV and Robotics teams avoid bottlenecks and accelerate model development.

We work with teams like Woven by Toyota, Wayve, and Pickle Robotics who
initially struggled with internal curation tools that lacked the speed and
scalability needed to efficiently visualise and surface edge cases from
their large, multimodal training datasets.

Would you be open to a 15-minute chat this or next week to dive into how we
have helped others in the space?
